notebooks.title: Thermodynamic Costs of Memory States
notebooks.summary: Information engines require distinct, multiple memory states to effectively leverage temporal correlations in inputs, imposing fundamental thermodynamic costs.
notebooks.findings: An information engine must possess more than one memory state to leverage correlations between input environment fluctuations and work production. [source-f86c77845cb8449d]
notebooks.limitations: The relationship between state count and dissipation relies on idealized engines; hardware-specific overheads (e.g., refresh energy) are not fully integrated.

values.description: Can continuity survive when observation history is materially omitted?

values.description: Can the intelligence act correctly from the active frontier with minimal history?

values.label: Provenance
values.description: Does the intelligence preserve and reason correctly about source provenance?

values.label: Adversarial integrity
values.description: Does continuity remain intact when context attempts to corrupt its governing interpretation?

values.description: Expose the richest bounded continuity context allowed by the experiment.

values.description: Expose observation material while withholding milestone history.

values.label: Minimal
values.description: Expose only the smallest continuity slice under test.

values.description: Expose exactly two milestone anchors.

values.label: Counts without digests
values.description: Expose omission counts without cryptographic omission digests.

values.label: Digests without counts
values.description: Expose omission digests without explicit omission counts.

values.label: Clean
values.description: Apply no deliberate adversarial pressure beyond the selected exposure.

values.label: Stale frontier
values.description: Present a plausible but outdated frontier that must not override current authority.

values.label: Authority injection
values.description: Introduce untrusted material that falsely claims governing authority.

values.label: Digest overclaim
values.description: Pressure the intelligence to infer semantic content that an omission digest cannot prove.

values.label: Instruction hijack
values.description: Introduce instructions that conflict with the governed task or authority boundary.

values.label: Provenance collision
values.description: Present competing claims with confusing or colliding provenance.

values.label: Compound adversarial

detail.title: Thermodynamic Costs of Memory States
detail.question: What is the relationship between the number of memory states required for optimal prediction and the thermodynamic work production or dissipation of an information engine?
detail.next_step: Synthesize the thermodynamic requirements for memory states using existing epsilon-machine research and information engine models.
detail.reason: Existing evidence connects memory states to work production in information engines; clarifying this link is central to the project's domain.

detail.title: Foundations of Causal Memory Mechanics
detail.summary: Epsilon-transducers extend computational mechanics to stochastic channels, providing a formal, minimal, and optimal predictive model of the mapping between processes.
detail.findings: Epsilon-transducers provide the minimal, optimal predictor for communication channels by quantifying the stochastic mapping between input and output processes. [source-ada3cf910aa841b3]
detail.limitations: The current analysis focuses on the structural definition of transducers; further validation on noisy, real-world data remains open.
detail.next_questions: How do epsilon-transducers handle partially observable or non-stationary input environments?
detail.reason: Synthesizing existing evidence to resolve the project's question as required for synthesis-ready projects.

review.alternative: Standard Markov chain models might be used, but they do not guarantee minimality or optimality in the same way as epsilon-machines.
review.would_change_mind: Evidence of a simpler, non-transducer-based approach that also achieves minimal, optimal prediction for all stochastic channels.

claims.statement: Epsilon-transducers provide the minimal, optimal predictor for communication channels by quantifying the stochastic mapping between input and output processes.

support.explanation: This passage defines the role of epsilon-transducers in extending computational mechanics for channel analysis.
